entry.title: Optimize Your Sampling: Tuned Diffusion Sampling with Bayesian Optimization
entry.summary: Sampling from a diffusion model typically requires many forward passes through a large neural network, making generation computationally expensive. entry.title: Comparative Study of Out-of-the-Box Technology for Automatic Target Detection and Recognition
entry.summary: Automatic Target Detection and Recognition (ATD/R) is critical for military decision support and (semi-)autonomous operations.
